posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
If you want a subprocess or subshell to access your local variables, you have to export them to make them environment variables instead.
To do this you can use the export command or the -x flag of declare.

Read more about them in help export and help declare, the help pages spell it out.
